prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1184; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a side impact collision at a controlled intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver's side by a third-party vehicle that entered the intersection against the signal. Police report requested. Liability appears clear on initial review, pending witness statement.

Entry 2: Claimant's counsel has provided notice of representation. All further contact to be routed through counsel. Claimant reports lower back strain following the impact and has been advised to obtain medical evaluation. Medical authorization requested through counsel.

Entry 3: Received police report. Officer noted the third-party driver admitted to failing to yield. Photos of both vehicles reviewed; damage consistent with reported point of impact. Independent appraisal ordered for the claimant's vehicle.

Entry 4: Counsel submitted treatment records from urgent care visit. Diagnosis is lumbar strain with muscle spasm. Physical therapy referral noted. Prior chiropractic history with the claimant disclosed but appears unrelated to the current complaint. Records forwarded to medical review for causation assessment.

Entry 5: Medical review completed. Soft tissue injury is consistent with the mechanism of loss; treatment plan is reasonable at this stage. Reserve adjusted to reflect ongoing physical therapy. Counsel to be advised of liability determination and invited to submit a demand package once treatment concludes.
